product_one_liner.value: BombBomb Engage lets sales, marketing, recruiting, and customer-facing teams create, send, and track personalized video messages across email, text, LinkedIn, and other channels to build stronger business relationships.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies Engage as a video engagement platform; the About page describes creating, sending, and tracking personalized videos.

pricing_page.notes: Public page lists Core and Pro prices and custom Enterprise pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both are identified in BombBomb customer case-study pages; the Madwire case study describes its team using BombBomb video email.

employee_band.notes: Built In reports 70 total employees, which falls within the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists Denver, Colorado as headquarters; Built In also lists Denver as HQ.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and BombBomb's About page state the company was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows marketing, how-to, and product-use content, but no qualifying engineering or technical posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: BombBomb has a multi-article Help Center and a public developer portal with API, OAuth, webhook, and getting-started documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job board states there are no open positions at this time.

model_provider.notes: Checked the Copilot/product information, public help documentation, security and privacy pages, and available blog materials; these identify AI capabilities but do not publicly identify the model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: BombBomb's Security & Compliance page explicitly claims SOC 2 Type II compliance. No other listed certification is included.

last_funding.notes: CB Insights lists the latest round as an Unattributed VC round of $2.43 million on March 12, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round shown is dated March 12, 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company job board states there are no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: BombBomb announced the new experience on October 22, 2026, and its October 27, 2026 What's New page describes the redesign and interface changes. This falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kathryn Adamson's profile lists her as BombBomb Vice President of Growth beginning March 2026, within the prior 12 months.

crm_stack_signal.notes: BombBomb's integration documentation names HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics Customer Insights, and Outreach; the pricing page names Salesforce among the Pro integrations.
